spec.name: Furniture Bat Garland
spec.description: A thin wall-mounted dark cord with a stepped swoop and three black bats. Raised wing tips, paired ears and painted orange bows create a festive survival-friendly silhouette. Front faces negative Z; all parts connect without supports.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: thin wall-mounted garland with a dark cord swooping in steps across the width, three stylized black bats with spread stepped wings and tiny orange bows; no support posts. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Wall attachment: ALL geometry stays in local z=12..15.75, flat rear at positive Z, decorated front facing negative Z. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
